steps.label: Intermediate
steps.sub: Reusable aggregation — not for direct BI use

code:
select
    order_id,
    sum(amount) as total_amount_paid,
    count(payment_id) as payment_count
from {{ ref('stg_jaffle_shop__payments') }}
group by 1
caption: Reused by more than one downstream mart.

code:
select
    customers.customer_id,
    customer_orders.first_order_date,
    coalesce(customer_orders.number_of_orders, 0) as number_of_orders,
    coalesce(customer_orders.lifetime_value, 0) as lifetime_value
from customers
left join customer_orders using (customer_id)
caption: A mart referencing ref('orders') — reusing work already resolved there.
